---\r\n\r\nFILE: TicketingSystemFightNight.Tests/Helpers/CustomWebApplicationFactory.cs\r\n\r\nusing Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting;\r\nusing Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;\r\nusing Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing;\r\nusing Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;\r\nusing Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;\r\nusing TicketingSystemFightNight.Data;\r\nusing TicketingSystemFightNight.Models;\r\n\r\nnamespace TicketingSystemFightNight.Tests.Helpers\r\n{\r\n    public class CustomWebApplicationFactory : WebApplicationFactory<Program>\r\n    {\r\n        private static int _dbCounter = 0;\r\n\r\n        protected override void ConfigureWebHost(IWebHostBuilder builder)\r\n        {\r\n            builder.ConfigureAppConfiguration((context, config) =>\r\n            {\r\n                var testSettings = new Dictionary<string, string?>\r\n                {\r\n                    [\"ConnectionStrings:VjezbaDbContext\"] = \"TestConnection\",\r\n                    [\"Authentication:Google:ClientId\"] = \"test-client-id\",\r\n                    [\"Authentication:Google:ClientSecret\"] = \"test-client-secret\"\r\n                };\r\n                config.AddInMemoryCollection(testSettings);\r\n            });\r\n\r\n            builder.ConfigureServices(services =>\r\n            {\r\n                // Remove real DbContext\r\n                var descriptor = services.SingleOrDefault(\r\n                    d => d.ServiceType == typeof(DbContextOptions<VjezbaDbContext>));\r\n                if (descriptor != null)\r\n                    services.Remove(descriptor);\r\n\r\n                // Use unique InMemory database per factory instance\r\n                var dbName = \"TestDb_\" + Interlocked.Increment(ref _dbCounter);\r\n                services.AddDbContext<VjezbaDbContext>(options =>\r\n                    options.UseInMemoryDatabase(dbName));\r\n            });\r\n\r\n            builder.UseEnvironment(\"Development\");\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n\r\n--- STEP 4: Create TestHelpers for seeding data ---\r\n\r\nFILE: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication;\r\nusing Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;\r\nusing Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;\r\nusing Microsoft.Extensions.Options;\r\nusing System.Security.Claims;\r\nusing System.Text.Encodings.Web;\r\n\r\nnamespace TicketingSystemFightNight.Tests.Helpers\r\n{\r\n    // Test authentication handler that allows bypassing real auth\r\n    public class TestAuthHandler : AuthenticationHandler<AuthenticationSchemeOptions>\r\n    {\r\n        public static bool IsAuthenticated { get; set; } = false;\r\n        public static string UserRole { get; set; } = \"Admin\";\r\n        public static string UserId { get; set; } = \"test-user-id\";\r\n\r\n        public TestAuthHandler(IOptionsMonitor<AuthenticationSchemeOptions> options,\r\n            ILoggerFactory logger, UrlEncoder encoder) : base(options, logger, encoder)\r\n        { }\r\n\r\n        protected override Task<AuthenticateResult> HandleAuthenticateAsync()\r\n        {\r\n            if (!IsAuthenticated)\r\n                return Task.FromResult(AuthenticateResult.Fail(\"Not authenticated\"));\r\n\r\n            var claims = new List<Claim>\r\n            {\r\n                new Claim(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, UserId),\r\n                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, \"Test Admin\"),\r\n                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Email, \"testadmin@test.com\"),\r\n                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, UserRole)\r\n            };\r\n\r\n            var identity = new ClaimsIdentity(claims, \"TestScheme\");\r\n            var principal = new ClaimsPrincipal(identity);\r\n            var ticket = new AuthenticationTicket(principal, \"TestScheme\");\r\n\r\n            return Task.FromResult(AuthenticateResult.Success(ticket));\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n\r\n--- STEP 6: Create AuthenticatedWebApplicationFactory ---\r\n\r\nFILE: TicketingSystemFightNight.Tests/Helpers/AuthenticatedWebApplicationFactory.cs\r\n\r\nusing Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication;\r\nusing Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting;\r\nusing Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing;\r\nusing Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;\r\nusing Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;\r\nusing TicketingSystemFightNight.Data;\r\n\r\nnamespace TicketingSystemFightNight.Tests.Helpers\r\n{\r\n    public class AuthenticatedWebApplicationFactory : WebApplicationFactory<Program>\r\n    {\r\n        private static int _dbCounter = 0;\r\n        public string DbName { get; } = \"AuthTestDb_\" + Interlocked.Increment(ref _dbCounter);\r\n\r\n        protected override void ConfigureWebHost(IWebHostBuilder builder)\r\n        {\r\n            builder.ConfigureAppConfiguration((context, config) =>\r\n            {\r\n                var testSettings = new Dictionary<string, string?>\r\n                {\r\n                    [\"ConnectionStrings:VjezbaDbContext\"] = \"TestConnection\",\r\n                    [\"Authentication:Google:ClientId\"] = \"test-client-id\",\r\n                    [\"Authentication:Google:ClientSecret\"] = \"test-client-secret\"\r\n                };\r\n                config.AddInMemoryCollection(testSettings);\r\n            });\r\n\r\n            builder.ConfigureServices(services =>\r\n            {\r\n                // Remove real DbContext\r\n                var descriptor = services.SingleOrDefault(\r\n                    d => d.ServiceType == typeof(DbContextOptions<VjezbaDbContext>));\r\n                if (descriptor != null)\r\n                    services.Remove(descriptor);\r\n\r\n                services.AddDbContext<VjezbaDbContext>(options =>\r\n                    options.UseInMemoryDatabase(DbName));\r\n\r\n                // Replace authentication with test handler\r\n                services.AddAuthentication(defaultScheme: \"TestScheme\")\r\n                    .AddScheme<AuthenticationSchemeOptions, TestAuthHandler>(\r\n } = \"AuthTestDb_\" + Interlocked.Increment(ref _dbCounter);\r\n\r\n        protected override void ConfigureWebHost(IWebHostBuilder builder)\r\n        {\r\n            builder.ConfigureAppConfiguration((context, config) =>\r\n            {\r\n                var testSettings = new Dictionary<string, string?>\r\n                {\r\n                    [\"ConnectionStrings:VjezbaDbContext\"] = \"TestConnection\",\r\n                    [\"Authentication:Google:ClientId\"] = \"test-client-id\",\r\n                    [\"Authentication:Google:ClientSecret\"] = \"test-client-secret\"\r\n                };\r\n                config.AddInMemoryCollection(testSettings);\r\n            });\r\n\r\n            builder.ConfigureServices(services =>\r\n            {\r\n                var descriptor = services.SingleOrDefault(\r\n                    d => d.ServiceType == typeof(DbContextOptions<VjezbaDbContext>));\r\n                if (descriptor != null)\r\n                    services.Remove(descriptor);\r\n\r\n                services.AddDbContext<VjezbaDbContext>(options =>\r\n                    options.UseInMemoryDatabase(DbName));\r\n\r\n                services.AddAuthentication(defaultScheme: \"TestScheme\")\r\n                    .AddScheme<TestAuthHandlerOptions, TestAuthHandler>(\r\n                        \"TestScheme\", options => { });\r\n            });\r\n\r\n            builder.UseEnvironment(\"Development\");\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        public HttpClient CreateAdminClient()\r\n        {\r\n            return CreateClient(new WebApplicationFactoryClientOptions(),\r\n                opts => { opts.IsAuthenticated = true;
